summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Casafeast Chef Portal. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed against public URL (validate, login/loginVerify, chef fetch, menu CRUD + toggle + soft-delete, orders accept/reject/dispatch, revenue math (20% + 18% GST), onboarding 4-step save, admin verify/activate/reset, support ticket, simulated file upload, seed). Frontend: E2E via Playwright covered — auth split screen + OTP dialog with demo hint, OTP verification, geofence lock with geo-simulate-visakhapatnam, activated chef dashboard (Overview/Orders/Revenue/Menu unlocked, On-Boarding hidden), TopBar (chef name/email/phone, notification bell → panel, profile menu → clear-cache + logout), menu-active shows 2 cards, menu-inactive shows 1, menu-edit-modal opens, create-menu form fields present, orders tabs & accept/reject buttons render, revenue KPIs (4)/area chart/pie/commission breakdown all render with ₹330 commission + ₹59.4 GST on ₹1650 gross. Onboarding-mode chef (newchef@casafeast.com) shows non-dismissible welcome-dialog, nav-revenue+groups locked with lock icons, nav-onboarding visible, welcome-onboarding-button opens wizard; Step 1 shows city/area/commission-banner (20% + 18% GST) and accept-terms. Admin console verified kyc/bank/field for newchef, backend flipped isActivated=true. Legal footer with TM Number 7810892 confirmed on Auth, Dashboard and Admin.

issues: WelcomeDialog is rendered by DashboardShell whenever !isActivated, so it reappears on top of the /app/onboarding wizard route — user must dismiss the modal via the Start Onboarding button repeatedly. Consider hiding WelcomeDialog when the route is already /app/onboarding, or only showing it once per session.
Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: (Optional/UX) Suppress WelcomeDialog on /app/onboarding route so it doesn't overlay the wizard.
(A11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to OTPDialog and other DialogContent instances to remove Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 605-line file mixing models, auth, onboarding, menu, orders, revenue, admin and seed. Consider splitting into routers/modules (auth.py, menu.py, orders.py, admin.py, seed.py) for maintainability once the app grows.
No auth guard on /admin routes — acceptable for the stated demo, but note it in docs and gate behind an env flag for any non-demo deployment.
requestLocation() in DashboardShell runs once on mount and uses eslint-disable-next-line for deps; refactor to reflect intentional single-run with a ref instead of disabling the rule.
Backend uses in-memory session tokens on chef doc (sessionToken) but no endpoint validates it — tokens are effectively decorative. Fine for demo but document explicitly.
